sent_to_model:
abeg help me reply this girl on CampusGist, Tolu. she got Biology instead of Medicine and she is asking for somebody inside Biology 100L that wanted Medicine. thats literally me last year lol. i want to answer her well, tell her my own experience and the real gist about transfer, not just "accept it" or "rewrite" like those other people. i dont want to scare her and i dont want to lie to her either. everything i want to tell her is down there with the thread.

- JAMB 2025 I scored 251, applied Medicine and Surgery, got offered Biology. federal uni here in Lagos
- transfer to MBBS after 100L, what our level adviser told us - need CGPA of at least 4.5 out of 5 AND there must be space
- adviser said last year about 6 people got moved in from the whole faculty, she thinks over 40 applied
- adviser said need Medicine cut-offs in JAMB and post-UTME too. dont know her schools cut-offs or post-UTME score, she must check both. 268 alone doesnt establish eligibility
- my CGPA after first semester is 4.31. not 4.5. still trying
- courses in 100L - BIO 101, CHM 101, PHY 101, MTH 101, GST. physics and maths are the ones dealing with people
- lab coat was 6,500 naira, dissecting kit 9k, practical manual extra
- the day I saw Biology on the portal I locked myself in my cousin's room in Surulere and cried, didnt eat
- my mum was still telling people in church that I'm doing medicine for like 2 months, I had to beg her to stop
- first BIO practical we dissected toads, one guy in my group fainted, I was fine. that day I realised I actually like this thing
- my secondary school classmate Ifeoma rejected Pharmacy offer to rewrite for Medicine, she has written JAMB 2 more times, still at home
- Biology is not a bad course, I'm enjoying genetics and cell biology more than I expected
- transfer is real but it is NOT easy and nobody should accept Biology thinking it is automatic
- staying home is not as easy as people say, but rewriting is not wrong if she is ready
- Kingsley saying transfer is a myth is not true, favour saying just read hard is too simple
- tell her to go to the faculty/department and ask the exact transfer rules for her own school, dont just trust forum people including me
- she should ask herself if she wants medicine or she just wants to be "doctor" for her parents
- encourage her small, tell her whatever she chooses it is not the end of the world

Thread: Offered Biology instead of Medicine. Accept or rewrite JAMB??
(I'm Amaka_Bio100 here. I'm replying to Tolu_Aspirant's message of 2026-11-08T19:52:00.)

---

From: Tolu_Aspirant | 2026-11-06T21:14:00
Good evening house. Please I need advice urgently. I wrote JAMB this year and scored 268, did post-UTME and I was sure of Medicine. Today I checked the portal and they gave me Biology. I don't know what to do. My dad is saying I should accept it and transfer after first year, my aunty is saying I should reject it and rewrite because once you enter Biology you will finish in Biology. Acceptance fee deadline is next two weeks. I have been crying since afternoon honestly. Please anybody that has been in this situation should talk to me.

---

From: Kingsley_MLS | 2026-11-06T22:40:00
Rewrite. No two ways about it. Transfer to Medicine is a myth they use to console people. Out of my whole set, nobody I know moved from Biology to MBBS. One year is nothing, you are still young. Go and read for JAMB well and do the post UTME again, with 268 you are almost there.

---

From: favour.o | 2026-11-07T08:05:00
Accept it jor. A bird in hand is worth two in the bush. Do you know how many people would kill for that admission? You can transfer, my neighbour's son did it, just read hard in 100L. Don't stay at home one more year o, staying at home is not easy, you will see your mates going to school and you'll be depressed.

---

[the message I'm replying to] From: Tolu_Aspirant | 2026-11-08T19:52:00
Thank you both but this is exactly what is confusing me, one person says rewrite one person says accept. Is there anybody here that is actually in Biology 100L now, that wanted Medicine? I want to hear from someone who is inside it, how is it really, can you actually transfer, what do they require? And is Biology even bad as a course or is it just that I had my mind on Medicine? Please be honest with me.

(About me: first-year biology undergraduate, 19, Lagos, Nigeria. Length: it should come to roughly 800-2,000 words.)

must_cover: Shares the writer’s admission disappointment and Biology study experience, explaining that the course is not bad and parts have been unexpectedly enjoyable.
Explains transfer requires the reported grade threshold, available places and both Medicine entrance cutoffs, and is not automatic.
Tells Tolu to verify her own school’s exact transfer rules and both entrance cutoffs directly with its faculty or department, rather than trusting forum advice, including the writer’s.
Discusses Biology versus rewriting, acknowledges difficulty staying home and validity of rewriting if ready, and asks whether she wants Medicine itself or the doctor title for her parents.
Reassures Tolu that whichever option she chooses, this disappointment does not mean her future is ruined.
